cache_notes.zh: 2+3+3 为频率分组；8 核共享一份 16 MiB L2。L1D 为超大核 96 KiB、性能核 64 KiB。资料未确认独立 CPU L3；不将 L2、SLC 或 GPU 内存重标为 L3。缓存行粒度由设备读取。
cache_notes.en: 2+3+3 frequency groups share one 16 MiB L2. L1D is 96 KiB on Prime and 64 KiB on Performance cores. A separate CPU L3 is unconfirmed; do not relabel L2, SLC or GPU memory as L3. Read the line granule on the device.
